project.name: AspiraPath AI
project.type: Generative AI Career and Education Guidance Platform

problem_statement.title: Bridging Career Aspiration and Achievable Action
problem_statement.description: Students often know what career they want but lack clarity about qualifications, skills, courses, certifications, projects, costs, study time, location requirements and practical next steps.
problem_statement.key_problem: Generic career guidance often does not consider an individual student's academic profile, skills, budget, time and geographic constraints.

proposed_solution.description: AspiraPath AI uses Generative AI to analyze a student's profile, career aspiration and constraints and generate a personalized education and career pathway.

financial: Preference for free or low-cost resources

core_innovation.name: Constraint-Aware Career Engine
core_innovation.description: The AI considers the student's real-world limitations and converts each constraint into an impact, workaround or alternative pathway.

features.name: Career Feasibility Analysis
features.purpose: Evaluate academic, skill, financial, time and geographic suitability.

features.name: Skill Gap Analysis
features.purpose: Compare current skills with target career requirements.

features.name: Education Pathway Generator
features.purpose: Generate traditional, skill-first, affordable and alternative pathways.

features.name: Personalized Learning Roadmap
features.purpose: Create staged learning plans based on the student's available study time.

features.name: Certification Roadmap
features.purpose: Recommend relevant certification categories without guaranteeing employment.

features.name: Project Generator
features.purpose: Recommend portfolio projects based on skill level.

features.name: Scholarship and Financial Guidance
features.purpose: Provide scholarship categories and low-cost alternatives while requiring official verification.

features.name: Weekly Action Planner
features.purpose: Convert long-term career goals into immediate weekly tasks.

features.name: Career Readiness Indicator
features.purpose: Provide an AI-generated guidance indicator rather than an employment probability.

features.name: Alternative Career Paths
features.purpose: Suggest related entry routes when the desired career has significant barriers.

features.name: Career Risk Analysis
features.purpose: Identify career risks and suggest mitigation.

features.name: What-If Career Simulator
features.purpose: Recalculate the career pathway when constraints change.

what_if_scenarios.expected_response: Shift toward free or low-cost learning and explain the effect on the timeline.

what_if_scenarios.example: Student can study only 1 hour per day
what_if_scenarios.expected_response: Create a slower but manageable learning roadmap.

what_if_scenarios.example: Student cannot move to another city
what_if_scenarios.expected_response: Prioritize local, remote and online opportunities.

what_if_scenarios.example: Student wants a job within six months
what_if_scenarios.expected_response: Prioritize essential skills, portfolio projects and entry-level pathways.

ai_prompt_principles: Use the student's profile instead of generic recommendations.
Never ignore budget, time, location or eligibility constraints.
Explain why each major recommendation was generated.
Do not guarantee admission, employment, salary, certification or career success.
Do not invent scholarships, fees, deadlines or eligibility requirements.
Clearly distinguish known information, assumptions and missing information.

privacy_rules: Collect only information necessary for career planning.
Do not request passwords, bank details or government identification numbers.
responsible_ai.disclaimer: AspiraPath AI provides personalized educational and career guidance based on information supplied by the user. Recommendations are not guarantees of admission, employment, salary, certification or career success. Eligibility, fees, scholarships, deadlines and institutional requirements should always be verified through official sources.

constraints_and_mitigations.mitigation: Avoid unsupported factual claims and encourage verification of official information.
Verify current fees, scholarships, deadlines and eligibility through official sources.
Present recommendations as guidance rather than guaranteed outcomes.
Identify missing information and explain that recommendations may change.
Provide multiple pathways and alternatives rather than prescribing one route.
Provide planning guidance instead of definitive financial advice.
Present the score only as an AI-generated guidance indicator.
Present the solution as a prototype with limited persistence, real-time data and external integrations.

expected_impact: Give students clarity and actionable career direction.
Help parents understand realistic education pathways.
Support teachers and career counselors with structured guidance.
Provide accessible pathways for students facing financial, time or location constraints.
hackathon_demo_flow: Enter the aspiration: I want to become an AI Engineer
innovation_statement: AspiraPath AI is a constraint-aware Generative AI career navigator that dynamically converts a student's aspirations and real-world limitations into personalized education, skill and career pathways.
pitch: Every student has a dream, but not every student knows the path to reach it. AspiraPath AI takes a student's aspiration, academic profile, skills, budget, time and location constraints and transforms them into a personalized career roadmap. It identifies skill gaps, recommends education pathways, projects and certification categories, creates a weekly action plan and provides an AI-based career-readiness indicator. Its key differentiator is the What-If Career Simulator, which dynamically creates a new pathway when a student changes a constraint. AspiraPath AI is an AI career navigator that answers: Given where I am today, my limitations and my aspirations, what can I realistically do next?
